title: Certify all admitted depths while keeping the contact and residual assumptions matched
statement: The accepted construction uses rational pi brackets,monotone radius bisection and integer-square-root enclosures across the full supplied depth interval. body: Do not mix nominal zero-residual service with residual-bearing acquisition as one protocol. A failing sufficient upper does not establish physical component failure. Actual contact stiffness,full switching,strict burial,lateral boundary correction,metrology and no-growth/reversibility are unacquired. No interaction/finite-component qualification or stronger-than-ordinary advantage follows. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
